raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer prematurely adopted a US-specific release year (1968) for Moment of Danger based on a snippet/knowledge panel and stated they would “use 1968,” despite reputable sources (Wikipedia, TCM) indicating an earlier 1960 UK premiere and even 1962 US references. This misinterprets the task (which requires the earliest theatrical release) and ignores cross-verification. Additionally, WebSurfer repeatedly failed to follow instructions to look up The Ballad of Josie at all, causing the process to loop without resolving the comparison.
